uint32_t deherm_dmsdk_borrowed_count(void) { return UINT32_C(80); }
const DehermDmSdkBorrowedDescriptor* deherm_dmsdk_borrowed_descriptors(void) { return kDescriptors; }

DehermDmSdkBorrowedStatus deherm_dmsdk_borrowed_set_provider(const DehermDmSdkBorrowedProvider* provider) {
  if (provider == nullptr) { memset(&gProvider, 0, sizeof(gProvider)); return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_OK; }
  if (provider->abi_version != DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_PROVIDER_ABI || provider->is_current_thread == nullptr || provider->validate_handle == nullptr || provider->invoke == nullptr) return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_INVALID_PROVIDER;
  gProvider = *provider;
  return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_OK;
}
DehermDmSdkBorrowedStatus deherm_dmsdk_borrowed_dispatch(uint16_t id, const uint64_t* arguments, uint32_t argument_count, uint64_t* out_result) {
  if (id >= deherm_dmsdk_borrowed_count()) return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_UNKNOWN_ID;
  const DehermDmSdkBorrowedDescriptor& descriptor = kDescriptors[id];
  DEHERM_PROFILE_TRANSPORT_SCOPE(DEHERM_PROFILE_TRANSPORT_C_ABI_NATIVE, id, kProfileContractShapes[id], kProfileNames[id]);
  if (argument_count != descriptor.argument_count) { DEHERM_PROFILE_SCOPE_FAILED(); return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_WRONG_ARITY; }
  if (out_result == nullptr || (argument_count != 0 && arguments == nullptr)) { DEHERM_PROFILE_SCOPE_FAILED(); return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_NULL_STORAGE; }
  if (gProvider.invoke == nullptr) { DEHERM_PROFILE_SCOPE_FAILED(); return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_PROVIDER_MISSING; }
  if (gProvider.is_current_thread(gProvider.context) == 0) { DEHERM_PROFILE_SCOPE_FAILED(); return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_WRONG_THREAD; }
  for (uint32_t index = 0; index < argument_count; ++index) {
    if (descriptor.argument_kinds[index] == DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_HANDLE && (arguments[index] == 0 || gProvider.validate_handle(gProvider.context, descriptor.handle_kinds[index], arguments[index]) == 0)) { DEHERM_PROFILE_SCOPE_FAILED(); return DEHERM_DMSDK_BORROWED_INVALID_HANDLE; }
  }
  return gProvider.invoke(gProvider.context, id, arguments, argument_count, out_result);
}
